article.headline: Take-Two Interactive Reaches $1.4 Billion in Sales During ‘GTA 6’ Preorder Opening Quarter
article.summary: Video game publisher Take-Two Interactive hit $1.39 billion in sales from April-June, the quarter during which it opened presales for “Grand Theft Auto VI.” Those figures are not broken down by title, but Take-Two notes the “largest contributors” to the overall number were “NBA® 2K, the Grand Theft Auto® series, Toon B…
